lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，压弯了草茎。
lines.en: I hop along and bend the grass stems.
I patrol this overgrown ground.
Ears up, I listen as I go.

lines.zh: 我后腿一蹬，跳过一道沟。
lines.en: A push of my hind legs clears a ditch.

lines.zh: 我沿着花丛走，那是边界。
lines.en: I walk the flowerbeds. That's the border.

lines.zh: 我鼻子一直在动，闻有没有外来的。
lines.en: My nose keeps working for anything foreign.
I thread the undergrowth steadily.
I come this way, then turn back.

lines.zh: 我踩在苔上，软软的没声。
lines.en: Moss underfoot, soft and silent.

lines.zh: 我脖子上的毛竖起来了一点。
lines.en: The fur on my neck prickles slightly.

lines.zh: 我绕着一棵大蘑菇走了半圈。
lines.en: I circle a big mushroom halfway.
I stop with a hind leg still lifted.
I sit with my forepaws tucked to my chest.

lines.zh: 耳朵转了一下，又转回来。
lines.en: One ear swings, then swings back.

lines.zh: 我在慢慢地嚼一片叶子。
lines.en: I'm chewing a leaf slowly.
I rub my face in the grass.

lines.zh: 我盯着一个方向看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at one spot a long while.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子湿湿的，一直在动。
lines.en: My nose is damp and never still.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，转了个方向坐。
lines.en: I hop up and sit facing the other way.
No unfamiliar smell on the wind.
I stretch my hind legs and lie low.

lines.zh: 有小虫飞过，我耳朵抖了抖。
lines.en: A bug flies past and my ear twitches.
You're on this side of the border.
My ears point your way.
Don't take two more steps.

lines.zh: 你一撒骨粉，我就抖出种子。
lines.en: One shake of bonemeal and I shake out seeds.
Have you come to take this ground?

lines.zh: 你的气味很重，我不习惯。
lines.en: Your smell is strong. I'm not used to it.
My nose is working fast.
I'm gauging how far you can jump.

lines.zh: 这一带的花，都是我看着长的。
lines.en: I've watched every flower here grow.

lines.zh: 离我的菜畦远一点，就不追。
lines.en: Stay away from my rows and I will not chase.
I spring a long way off.
Ears flat, I'm angry.
My hind leg is bitten; I hop crooked.

lines.zh: 我缩进草丛里，只露耳朵。
lines.en: I shrink into the grass, only ears showing.
I'll give that back.
My nose stings and my eyes water.
I lie low and breathe slowly.
It hurts, but I won't leave this ground.
I chew twice and recover.

lines.zh: 等我缓过来，就撞你膝盖。
lines.en: When I recover, I will hit your knee.
The smell of bonemeal is peculiar.

lines.zh: 你撒下来的东西，落在草上。
lines.en: What you scattered has fallen on the grass.
I go over and sniff twice.
This smell makes me drop things.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下耳朵，又抖了抖。
lines.en: I shake an ear, then shake it again.
Scatter a little more. Right here.

lines.zh: 我后脚在地上刨了两下。
lines.en: I scuff the ground with a hind foot.
This stuff is sharp.

lines.zh: 我有点站不稳，鼻子发痒。
lines.en: I'm a bit unsteady and my nose itches.
Fine. I'll shake for you.
You stepped on my hind leg.
I spring aside and look back.
I'm small. Don't crowd me.
One bound and I'm in the grass.
You knocked the grass from my mouth.
Ears up, I'm not pleased.
I retreat behind the mushroom.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的菜地，我记住你。
lines.en: You stepped in my garden. I remember you.
Do not poke my seedlings with your boot.
I shake my fur straight again.
There aren't many of my kind on this ground.
We run two circles round the flowers.
Do you keep this patch too?

lines.zh: 我耳朵竖着，是愿意的意思。
lines.en: Ears up means I'm willing.

lines.zh: 先看看你赶不赶得走外来的。
lines.en: First, let's see if you can drive off outsiders.
The moss is softer. Let's go there.
Let's not be loud. Quiet is better.

lines.zh: 同族在一起，这片地才守得住。
lines.en: Together, our kind can hold this ground.

lines.zh: 我鼻子碰了碰你的鼻子。
lines.en: I touch my nose to yours.
When it's dark, we'll keep watch separately.

lines.zh: 这片叶子掉了，我捡起来。
lines.en: A leaf fell; I pick it up.
I take the seed in one bite.
I pin it with a forepaw. Steady.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我一个个收。
lines.en: I gather each thing that fell.
This is hard. I can't bite it.
I bury it under the moss.
This seed I'll keep.
I stuff this handful of seeds into my cheek.
I carry it back into the grass.
Tucked away. Don't let the wind take it.
Something snapped a twig over there.
My ears swing toward it at once.

lines.zh: 那不是这片林子的味道。
lines.en: That's not a smell from this wood.
I flatten down, hind legs gathered.

lines.zh: 长耳朵一转，我锁住它了。
lines.en: My long ears swivel; it is locked.
It moved. So it's begun.
Sprinkle bone meal and I drop seeds.

lines.zh: 兔耳一竖，数着你的步数。
lines.en: Ears up, I'm counting your steps.
Right. I've got it.
Not one step further.
I'll hop once to test its reaction.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵能听见它换气。
lines.en: My ears catch it drawing breath.

lines.zh: 我把它逼到蘑菇圈外面。
lines.en: I press it out past the mushroom ring.

lines.zh: 它每退一步，我就蹦进一步。
lines.en: Each step it retreats, I hop one in.
I counted three. It hasn't moved.
I'm not giving up this line today.
I circle it, crowding it.
I hop forward one pace at a time.
It's backed to the flowerbeds.
I watch its feet, not its head.
I spring in from the side.
It's trying to get behind me.

lines.zh: 这一圈绕完，就到它近处。
lines.en: When this circle closes, I'm close.
I pause to gather myself.
The grass is thick; it can't see me well.
One more bite of my greens and I kick.

lines.zh: 它后退了，我再逼近一步。
lines.en: It backs off; I close one more step.
All this ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我蹲在草里，只露耳朵尖。
lines.en: I crouch in the grass with only my ear tips out.

lines.zh: 它想从左边过，我先到了。
lines.en: It wants the left. I'm there first.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，压着它的节奏。
lines.en: I hop and hop, breaking its rhythm.

lines.zh: 我的后腿一直收着，随时能弹。
lines.en: My hind legs stay gathered, ready to spring.
It's looking for a way through. It won't find one.
My ears catch it shifting its feet.

lines.zh: 再绕半圈，它就背对花丛了。
lines.en: Half a turn more and its back is to the flowers.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的膝盖，那儿最软。
lines.en: I watch its knees. Softest part.
I kick off my hind legs and ram it.

lines.zh: 这一下正好撞在膝盖上。
lines.en: That caught it right on the knee.
I rake with a forepaw.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在它的裤脚上。
lines.en: I sink my teeth in its trouser leg.
It gave ground; I press.
I leap and strike from above.
Not heavy, but quick.
I knock it out of the flowerbed.
I land and turn square to it.
One more and it'll leave.
My hind legs are strong.
It missed; I'm already clear.
That was for this ground.
One kick sends you back three rows.
It's still here. I'll drive it again.
My ears are flat back.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在它的小腿上。
lines.en: I butt my head into its shin.

lines.zh: 这一下把它撞得歪了一下。
lines.en: That knocked it off balance.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里蹿出来咬一口。
lines.en: I burst from the grass and bite.

lines.zh: 我蹬墙借力，从上方下来。
lines.en: I kick off a wall and come from above.
I push out of the vines.

lines.zh: 这地方蔓生得厉害，正合适。
lines.en: Nicely overgrown here. Right for me.

lines.zh: 我落地时踩弯了一株草。
lines.en: I land and bend a stalk.

lines.zh: 我先绕了一圈看看边界。
lines.en: I walk one circuit to check the borders.
Lots of flowers. I've noted where.
I shake my ears and settle.
Thick moss here. I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我是这片地的主要住户之一。
lines.en: I'm one of this ground's main occupants.
I lift my nose and sniff it all.
First I must find the borders.
I crouch and survey.
I watch over this ground now.
Fire passes and my fur's singed.
I come down hard on the moss.
Water closes over me and I kick wildly.

lines.zh: 菜叶炸飞了，我也被掀翻。
lines.en: My leaves blow away; I am flipped too.

lines.zh: 骨粉一撒，我的种子掉了一地。
lines.en: A sprinkle of bonemeal and my seeds spill out.
That force stiffens my legs.

lines.zh: 草被踩光了，我找不到吃的。
lines.en: The grass is trampled; I can't find food.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我弹起来又落下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; I leap and drop.

lines.zh: 虚空里没土，我无处扎根。
lines.en: No soil in the void; nowhere to root.
